facts.fact: The Central Bank of Egypt agreed to join PAPSS in November 2024, and Egypt is described as one of the largest economies in the PAPSS network.

Afreximbank plans to connect PAPSS to Egypt's InstaPay, six Egyptian banks have applied to the Central Bank of Egypt for final integration approval, and a cross-border gateway layer still has to be built, said PAPSS chief executive Mike Ogbalu.
Egypt is described as one of the largest economies in the PAPSS network, which the Central Bank of Egypt agreed to join in November 2024.

EGY.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
InstaPay is called a domestic instant payments rail, but no wallet or mobile money service or interoperability is stated.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
